example_statement: Ministry of Agriculture Crop Forecast Survey Index (CFSI) projects 40% or greater crop losses
notes: accumulation_window_units and persistence_units set to 'n/a' per domain rules

example_statement: Crop yield reduction predicted to be more than 50% based on LEAP index
notes: accumulation_window_units and persistence_units set to 'n/a' per domain rules

example_statement: Fodder deficit of 40% or more
notes: accumulation_window_units and persistence_units set to 'n/a' per domain rules

example_statement: Trigger if pasture condition score falls below 40 indicating poor fodder availability.
notes: Condition score is an index from field or remote sensing data, no accumulation window applies.

example_statement: Trigger upon issuance of advisory bulletin for potential flood risk.
notes: Advisory bulletins are discrete events, no forecast probability or lead time applies.

example_statement: Trigger if crisis alert category is raised to orange or red for the affected area (e.g. PAGASA orange warning level).
notes: Crisis alert category captures colour-coded alert systems (red/orange/yellow/green). The colour is the value; the subcategory is the category concept. No forecast probability or lead time applies — alert issuance is a discrete event.

example_statement: Trigger if storm signal level 3 is issued for the coastal area.
notes: Storm signal levels are categorical warnings without forecast probability or lead time.

example_statement: Ignition probability equal to or greater than 70%
notes: Fire Risk canonical variable not in scope; retained as is with domain rules applied where possible

example_statement: Observed Conditions: Relative humidity (Rh) of 45 percent or higher in the respective city where Tmax condition is met
notes: Humidity canonical variable not in scope; retained as is with domain rules applied where possible

example_statement: Predicted increase in Sudd inundation extent over the next two months greater than 5% compared to seasonal minimum
notes: persistence_applicable set to 'conditional' as per original; accumulation_window_units and persistence_units set to 'n/a' per domain rules

example_statement: Trigger if river flow exceeds the 100-year return period level at station X.
notes: Return period exceedance is a threshold exceedance at a station or basin, geographic scope mandatory.

example_statement: River flow above 150,000 cusecs at Nowshera station of Kabul River predicted by flood bulletin C and significant flood warnings/advisories with 3-5 days lead time
notes: accumulation_window_units set to 'n/a' per domain rules

example_statement: Trigger if water level remains above 5 m for 12 consecutive hours at gauge Y.
notes: Water level persistence applies for flood duration assessment, geographic scope mandatory.

example_statement: Trigger if AWD cases exceed 50 in the district within 24 hours.
notes: AWD cases are real-time counts, no forecast probability or lead time applies.

example_statement: One confirmed cholera case reported by EPHI in a neighbouring woreda/district of the 20 identified woredas/districts within the same country or neighboring district of bordering country
notes: canonical_variable changed from 'Infectious Disease Incidence' to 'Infectious Disease' per domain canonical variables; lead_time_applicable set to 'no' for observational subcategory; persistence_units and accumulation_window_units set per domain rules

example_statement: Weekly dengue caseload exceeding 1,500 cases in May, June, July, December, and January
Trigger if GAM rate exceeds 15% in the region.
notes: Malnutrition rate is a measured prevalence, no forecast probability or lead time applies.

example_statement: Nino3.4 index equal or greater than 0.5K in NDJ average forecast issued in July
Weekly Extreme Forecast Index (EFI) from ECMWF model greater than 0.8
Predicted water levels of Babai and West Rapti rivers to rise to their existing danger levels at Chepang and Kusum stations respectively within next 48 hours
Vulnerability Assessment Analysis report issued in January projects 20% of the population in drought-induced IPC Phase 3 and 4 in January
Category 3 – 30% or higher excess mortality (ranging upwards as high as 45% to 65% excess daily mortality)
Trigger threshold: Category 3 with predicted excess mortality of 45% or higher
Trigger if EFI exceeds 1.5 for the 7-day period forecast.
notes: EFI is a standardized index with fixed climatological period, no accumulation window applies.

example_statement: Trigger if rainfall anomaly exceeds +30% over the past 30 days.
notes: Anomaly can be expressed as absolute or percent departure from normal rainfall.

example_statement: If first trigger not activated, activation requires IBF model detection of drought by April and official drought declaration by Government of Zimbabwe
notes: Seasonal total is a fixed climatological period, so accumulation_window_applicable set to no

example_statement: Trigger if SPI for 3 months is below -1.5 indicating drought conditions.
notes: SPI uses fixed climatological periods, accumulation window does not apply.

example_statement: Numerical weather prediction (NWP) or special weather advisories predict extreme and widespread rainfall for next three days across Babai and West Rapti basin areas and districts, provided rivers are flowing at stage level less than 2m below existing danger level
Cold wave forecast with a lead time of 4 days (event); or 72-hour confirmation with at least 75% probability of cold wave occurrence (%).
notes: Merged: Cold Wave + Cold wave event. Unit 'event' = binary cold wave occurrence; '%' = probability threshold.

example_statement: Heat Index corresponds to more than 90th percentile values for summer months (March-May)
Forecast lead time maximum 5 days including 3 days heatwave duration
Forecast Criteria: DHM issues a red alert heatwave bulletin ('take action') for the next 3 days in the target city or its associated district
72-hour forecast of heatwave occurrence (event); or probability of heatwave occurrence exceeds threshold (%).
notes: Merged: Heatwave occurrence (event) + Heatwave occurrence probability (%). Unit 'event' = binary confirmation; '%' = probability threshold.

example_statement: Daily maximum temperature above the 99th percentile threshold; or max day temperature 2°C or less for cold wave; or above 95th percentile of monthly historical maximum temperature.
notes: Merged: Max daily temp + Max daily temperature + Max temperature + Daytime temperature. All refer to daily maximum temperature as the trigger variable.

example_statement: 7-day temperature forecast minimum below -40°C (-35°C in Karaganda region) with precipitation and increased wind speed persisting for at least two days in any district
notes: Merged: Min temperature + General temperature. Regional min temp thresholds (General temperature) are a subtype of Min temperature.

example_statement: Trigger if temperature anomaly exceeds +2°C for the month.
notes: Anomaly is departure from climatological normal, no accumulation window applies.

example_statement: Trigger if wind chill index remains below -10°C for 6 consecutive hours.
notes: Wind chill index requires persistence to define cold wave conditions.

example_statement: Significant increase in internal volcanic activity parameters such as seismicity, gas emissions, ground deformation — trigger when monitoring authority declares significant anomaly.
notes: Observational subcategory: real-time monitoring data (seismicity counts, CO2/SO2 ppm, ground deformation). No forecast probability or lead time — geographic scope always required (named volcano/station).

example_statement: Eruptive event with explosive index VEI 3 and ash fall exceeding 2 mm as per ASH3D model (Special Report C)

Level 2 (orange alert) bulletin received four days before impact, triggered by anomalies such as second-level seismic crisis, second-level micro-deformation of the ground, and changes in gas composition (carbon dioxide accumulation) persisting for several hours a day.
notes: Alert level issued by the national volcanic monitoring authority (e.g. Level 1/2/3 or green/orange/red). Lead time applies — bulletin is issued days before expected impact. Geographic scope always required (named volcano). This subcategory tracks the official alert code, not ash deposition volume.

example_statement: At least two models among BMD, IMD, ECMWF, GFS, JTWC forecast wind speeds of 125 km/h or greater in coastal districts of Bangladesh with a lead time of 72 hours or more
notes: persistence_applicable set to yes due to sustained winds rule; probability and lead_time set to optional for forecast-based subcategory

example_statement: Category 4 or 5 cyclone within 250 km of Fiji
notes: persistence_applicable set to yes due to sustained winds rule; probability and lead_time set to optional/yes for forecast-based subcategory

example_statement: Threshold exceeded in at least 3 of the 23 ASAL counties based on drought monitoring indicators.
notes: Drought severity expressed as geographic coverage — number of admin units meeting drought threshold. Count_threshold geographic scope type applies.

example_statement: FEWSNET food insecurity projection at least 0.7 in derived population-weighted index in the same district.
notes: Food insecurity composite index from FEWSNET IPC analysis. Index value is the threshold; no forecast probability — model output only.

example_statement: Cold wave conditions sustained for 3 consecutive days trigger activation.
notes: Duration-based trigger: persistence of cold wave conditions as number of consecutive days. Distinct from temperature value threshold.

example_statement: 80% likelihood of complete damage to more than 50,000 houses.
notes: Probability-of-damage threshold expressed as percentage likelihood; house count is in threshold_value field.

example_statement: 60% likelihood of complete damage to more than 160,000 houses based on typhoon wind model.
notes: Physical structure damage threshold expressed as probability of exceedance; house count is in threshold_value field.

example_statement: Red warning (alert) issued when rainfall intensity exceeds 20 mm/hr or daily total exceeds 100 mm.
notes: Rainfall intensity measures rate (mm/hr) distinct from total accumulation. Accumulation window captures the measurement period.
